blocks.note: Layer A reaches this repo two ways, and never both at once. On v2 it is the vendored tree under .agents/vendor/harness, which the .agents drop removes here; on main it is the plugin, which nothing else in the tree would enable.

substitutions.note: Every reference to the canonical directory, as a path fragment.
And as a path *segment* — `join(root, '.agents', 'skills')` never contains a slash.
Article agreement: "an AGENTS.md" would otherwise become "an CLAUDE.md". Must precede the rule below, which would consume the noun first.
The instruction file itself, in prose and in glob patterns.
